title: Refrigerated/Heating Circulator IAW Salients
agency: INTERIOR, DEPARTMENT OF THE.US GEOLOGICAL SURVEY.OFC OF ACQUSITION  GRANTS-NATIONAL
description_text: The U.S. Geological Survey Hydrological Instrumentation Facility has a requirement for the delivery of a Refrigerated/Heating Circulator IAW Salients to Tuscaloosa, AL within 30 days from the date the contractor receives the purchase order. Request for Quote (RFQ) 140G0126Q0084 will be issued on or about 3/30/2026 with written quotes due on 4/2/2026 at 11:00 AM ED. Questions may be emailed to Cynthia Nicanor, Email: cynthia_nicanor@ios.doi.gov, before 4/1/2026 at 11:00 AM ED. Questions received after that time and date may not be responded to. This acquisition is a total small business set-aside. The NAICS code is 334516. The size standard 1000 employees. The anticipated award date of the contract is 4/30/2026. A vendor must be registered at https://www.sam.gov/index.html to be awarded the contract. All responsible sources may submit a bid or quotation which shall be considered by the agency. Responses may be emailed to cynthia_nicanor@ios.doi.gov.
